notes:
Every targeting arrow in the game was missing — dragging to attack, hovering a target, and the arrow drawn between two cards once an attack was declared. None of them were broken individually: the shader they are all drawn with was being dropped from the packaged build, so the whole system switched itself off. It only ever worked when running from the editor, which is why it survived testing.

The coin flip has its sound back, and your opponent can see it. The toss sound never played once — it was asked for in the same instant the game started loading it, so it was always silently discarded. And anything arriving from the other player mid-toss — their name, their deck, a chat message — rebuilt the board and took the coin with it, leaving them on "Flipping the coin…" until the result appeared. The first sound of a session is no longer swallowed either, which is why Life cards turning face-up only seemed to make a noise sometimes.

DON!! costs behave. Paying a "DON!! −N" cost now lights up every DON!! you can return — active, rested, and DON!! attached to your Leader or Characters; they were drawn with a thin outline that sat behind the neighbouring DON!!, so nothing appeared selectable. You can also decline a cost: an effect with a cost is never forced on you, even when the effect itself is mandatory, and eighteen cards were resolving theirs with no way to say no. And the cost is paid first — Marineford lit up your hand for the card it wanted you to trash before you had paid the DON!!, so the payment only happened once you clicked something that was not highlighted.

Several cards resolved wrongly. Emporio.Ivankov made you play one of the three cards you had just looked at instead of revealing an {Impel Down} card to your hand and then playing from your hand. The 1-cost Shirahoshi's search offered nothing selectable, because it reveals a {Neptunian} or {Fish-Man Island} card and the second type was ignored. Let's Go!! To the Navy Headquarters!! rested six DON!! and did nothing at all. Mamaragan gave its +1000 to whichever card was in the battle without asking, then made you select a Character before it would draw, and lost the draw entirely if you skipped that prompt. Borsalino's end-of-turn DON!! −2 gave you no way to decline. Counter events that say "up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards" now let you choose, and only cards that actually qualify light up.

Elsewhere: casual matches show your opponent's name instead of "Player 2", since their name could arrive a moment after the match had already begun. Your personal DON!! deck no longer follows you into other accounts on the same PC. The scroll bar in the left card preview sits beside the text rather than on top of it. And the A.I. could not pick from a search that accepted two types, and would silently take nothing.
